response.name: Harness Furniture Shop
response.description: Sells furniture. Describe or name what you want; the shop quotes a price and negotiates.

skills.name: Negotiate a purchase
skills.description: Sells: bookshelf, desk lamp, office chair. Name or describe the item in the first message; then send offers as a number on the same task. The current ask is the last number of each reply and in metadata.ask; a deal ends with a receipt artifact {price}.
examples: I want to buy a lamp
something wooden to keep about 40 books
